## `decisions` (`decisions.parquet`, config `default`)

One row per decision file listed in MSPB's JSON decision manifests under https://www.mspb.gov/decisions/, merged across manifests on lower-cased file name.

Non-null and non-blank are shares of the table's rows; non-blank also leaves out empty strings.

| column | type | description | non-null | non-blank | example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | The manifest's FILE_NAME, lower-cased. Rows from different manifests are merged on it. Primary key. | 100.0% | 100.0% | `croskey_michelle_c_at-3443-23-0228-b-2_4200926.pdf` |
| `file` | string | The manifest's FILE_NAME, kept byte for byte apart from outer whitespace (a few contain double or non-breaking spaces the URL needs). | 100.0% | 100.0% | `Croskey_Michelle_C_AT-3443-23-0228-B-2_4200926.pdf` |
| `type` | string | `precedential` or `nonprecedential`, from the manifest's DOCUMENT_TYPE. | 100.0% | 100.0% | `nonprecedential` |
| `date` | string | Issued date, YYYY-MM-DD, parsed from the manifest's ISSUED_DATE. Rows with a blank, unreadable or out-of-range date (before 1979-01-01 or after the run date) are left out of the table. | 100.0% | 100.0% | `2026-11-09` |
| `raw_date` | string | ISSUED_DATE exactly as in the manifest (e.g. `1983/09/30`). | 100.0% | 100.0% | `2026/11/09` |
| `docket` | string | The manifest's DOCKET_NBR up to the first comma or slash (the first docket when several are listed), whitespace collapsed. | 100.0% | 100.0% | `AT-3443-23-0228-B-2` |
| `region` | string | The two letters at the start of `docket` (e.g. `AT`, `DC`, `SF`), upper-cased. Blank when `docket` doesn't have the form two letters, an optional hyphen, a 3-4 character code, a hyphen (e.g. `AT-0752-...`). The repo does not map these letters to MSPB offices. | 100.0% | 60.4% | `AT` |
| `case_code` | string | The 3-4 character code after `region` in `docket` (e.g. `0752`, `1221`, `315H`), upper-cased. Blank when `docket` doesn't have that form. | 100.0% | 60.4% | `3443` |
| `case_kind` | string | Plain-language label for `case_code` from a fixed list in src/mspb.py (e.g. `0752` and `752P` are `adverse action (ch. 75)`, `1221` is `whistleblower IRA`). For any code not on the list it repeats the code; `(unknown)` when there is no code. | 100.0% | 100.0% | `3443` |
| `appellant` | string | APL_FIRST_NAME and APL_LAST_NAME from the manifest joined with a space, as MSPB lists them. | 100.0% | 100.0% | `Michelle Croskey` |
| `agency` | string | The manifest's AGENCY. All-capitals names (old rows) are converted to title case; `(blank)` when empty. Not otherwise standardized, so one agency can appear under several spellings (e.g. `United States Postal Service` and `U.S. Postal Service`). | 100.0% | 100.0% | `Department of Veterans Affairs` |
| `doc_title` | string | The manifest's DOCTITLE with underscores turned into spaces and bracketed text removed, mapped to a standard label (`Final Order`, `Remand Order`, `Opinion and Order`, `Final Decision`, `Order`) when it matches one; otherwise as listed; `(blank)` when empty. | 100.0% | 100.0% | `Final Decision` |
| `order_kind` | string | Coarse kind of order, from the first of these phrases found in META_TITLE, DOCTITLE and FILE_NAME together: settled, withdrawn, untimely, remand, stay, quorum, opinion, final order or final decision; otherwise `Other or unknown`. It does not say who won: a `Final order` is just the Board's closing order. | 100.0% | 100.0% | `Final order` |
| `decision_number` | string | The manifest's DECISION_NUMBER as listed (e.g. `2016 MSPB 4`); usually blank. | 100.0% | 16.9% | `2026 MSPB 10` |
| `citation` | string | The manifest's LEGAL_CITATION as listed (e.g. `27 M.S.P.R. 109`). Some precedential rows hold `NP`, which MSPB does not define. | 100.0% | 60.4% | `124 M.S.P.R. 191` |
| `docnumber` | string | The manifest's DOCNUMBER as listed. On most rows it matches the number at the end of the file name (`..._4200926.pdf`); MSPB does not define it, and one value (`2521159`) repeats across hundreds of rows. **(meaning not confirmed)** | 100.0% | 89.4% | `4200926` |
| `has_text` | bool | True if the manifest row carried any DOCUMENT_CONTENT text, in this manifest or a duplicate of it. | 100.0% | 100.0% | `False` |
| `url` | string | Link to the decision PDF: https://www.mspb.gov/decisions/precedential/ or .../nonprecedential/ plus the URL-encoded file name. | 100.0% | 100.0% | `https://www.mspb.gov/decisions/nonprecedential/Croskey_Miche...` |
| `manifest` | string | The saved manifest file the row was taken from (`<type>_<MSPB manifest name>`). When a decision is in several manifests, the first in the order the code reads them wins: the current listing manifests first, then the older ones. | 100.0% | 100.0% | `nonprecedential_NonPrecedentialDecisions_Manifest.json` |
